label: shadcn/ui + Tailwind
description: Copy-in Radix primitives styled with Tailwind.

vars.name: shadcn/ui + Tailwind

context: UI primitives are shadcn components copied into `<% ui-kit.component_root %>` — they are project source, not a dependency
rules: Add a primitive with `<% ui-kit.add_cmd %>` rather than hand-writing it, then edit the copied file freely

scaffold.$comment: Verified: `shadcn init -d -y` writes components.json and src/lib/utils.ts, and the app still builds. The -d flag is load-bearing — shadcn 4.x added an interactive component-library picker that -y alone does NOT skip, so without -d this command blocks forever waiting on stdin.
